messages:
Maya: Quick heads-up — I pushed the initial ref-arch + Terraform modules for the CloudPartner marketplace accelerator to GitHub. Ready for partner handoff review. TL;DR: module + example app + CI matrix for arm64/amd64.
Oliver: Nice, can you call out the repo? also we need a clear semver plan for the modules so partners can pin stable releases.
Maya: Repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/marketplace-accelerators/tree/cloudpartner-x-refarch
Maya: Semver plan: v0.x for preview, v1.0 when we cut marketplace listing. I'll draft a VERSIONING.md.
Sanjay: saw the modules — two quick notes: (1) grpc driver dependency for Ampere instances needs explicit deb package in the bootstrap; (2) resource naming conventions should avoid account-specific prefixes.
Aline: @Maya thanks — from partner-side we'll need an example GCP IAP + marketplace listing artifact. Also CI that runs an end-to-end smoke test (deploy -> healthcheck -> shutdown). Can you include a sample cloudbuild/tekton job?
Maya: added cloudbuild.yaml under examples/, and a GitHub Actions workflow that exercises terraform fmt/validate/plan + a smoke deploy to a tiny instance. Link: ./examples/github-actions-ci.yaml
Maya: example terraform usage: `module "redwood_refarch" { source = "github.com/redwood-inference/marketplace-accelerators//modules/refarch" version = "0.1.0" project_id = var.project_id machine_type = "c2-standard-4" }`
Oliver: Good. Also please pin provider versions and add terraform-docs output so marketplace listing can auto-generate the params table.
Sanjay: Agreed on provider pinning. For Ampere/Graviton compatibility matrix, add a small matrix in the README: tested images, kernel versions, and required flags (e.g., `--enable-ampere-opt`).
Tom: Security check: we need KMS integration guidance — how secrets are injected, recommended IAM roles, and an HSM option for private deployments. Also include a short threat model note for marketplace submission.
Maya: Will add KMS/HSM section and a checklist: create key, grant `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` to service account, set TF var `kms_key = "projects/.../locations/.../keyRings/.../cryptoKeys/..."`. I'll drop that under docs/ops.md.
Aline: For marketplace packaging: we need the install scripts to be idempotent and a container image tag policy. Partners want a `--dry-run` install flag and a small smoke image tagged `redwood/refarch:smoke-v0.1`.
Maya: adding `--dry-run` to installer and a smoke image. Also adding a quickstart that runs `curl -fsS http://$INGRESS/health || exit 1` as the smoke test.
Sanjay: Add a CI job step: `curl --retry 5 --fail http://$INGRESS/health` and terraform destroy in cleanup. Keep timeouts conservative for marketplace test harness.
deploy-bot: build #432 passed — examples/ci matrix (arm64, amd64) ✅ :thumbsup:
Oliver: Can we schedule a 30-min handoff with partner eng next Tue? want to walk the install, marketplace checklist, and the QA matrix.
Aline: Tuesday works. prefer 10am PT. I'll bring the partner release engineer.
Maya: booked calendar invite for Tue 10am PT. I'll open a PR with the README updates, VERSIONING.md, and ops checklist by EOD tomorrow.
Tom: please add the minimal IAM example snippet to ops.md so partners can copy/paste.
Maya: will do. Final ask: reviewers, please check examples/linux-bootstrap.sh for Ampere driver steps and the cloudbuild trigger names. Ping me on any blockers. :rocket:
